sampling_model.design: Population identification uses a square fully observed cyclic LiNG model with independent nondegenerate errors and at most one Gaussian coordinate. Inference uses independent observations from one fixed law in the FOBI subclass, whose eigengaps are gaps among distinct centered standardized fourth cumulants.
sampling_model.units: The observations \(X_1,\ldots,X_m\) are independent draws from one fixed \(q\)-variate equilibrium law.
sampling_model.treatment: There is no treatment variable in the core identification theorem; a later atomic intervention reveals a matching edge and is the downstream consumer.
sampling_model.overlap: No propensity-score overlap condition is used.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The sample covariance whitens the observations, the sample FOBI eigensystem estimates row directions, and the plug-in influence functions calibrate a symmetrized matrix region. Because empirical eigenvector signs may change, covariance consistency is asserted only modulo signed-row conjugacy. Coverage and contraction are pointwise; no graph support is assumed known, and no uniform claim is made near vanishing FOBI eigengaps, zero normalization denominators, or unit-circle stability boundaries.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: LiNG-D outputs the complete distribution-entailment equivalence class and stability selects at most one candidate when the true graph has disjoint cycles.
Distribution-equivalent cyclic LiNG graphs correspond to perfect matchings, their SCCs are invariant, and unfiltered matching samples estimate intervention reward.
The permanent of every nonnegative matrix has a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme.
Counting independent sets is \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete even for graphs of maximum degree three.
Unless \(\mathrm{NP}=\mathrm{RP}\), no FPRAS counts independent sets on graphs of maximum degree six.
All perfect matchings of a bipartite graph can be enumerated in output-sensitive total time with linear work per matching after preprocessing.
Under bounded eighth moments and distinct kurtoses, the FOBI unmixing estimator has an explicit joint root-sample-size expansion.
Inversion of a sample criterion yields confidence regions for an identified parameter set with consistency and coverage theory.
Discontinuity of a functional prevents nontrivial locally uniform confidence procedures in general.
StableSpIn learns cyclic linear models under the absolute spectral-radius restriction \(\rho(|B|)<1\).

body.tldr: A fully observed cyclic LiNG law identifies a finite monomial row-assignment orbit, while equilibrium stability imposes a global spectral filter on that orbit. The explicit rational \(3n\)-variable construction \(W_G\) has complete stable orbit \(\{\pi_S:S\in\mathcal I(G)\}\), with graph-uniform radial margins established by a pole-free, multiplicity-preserving analytic determinant homotopy. Consequently stable-orbit counting is \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete and has no FPRAS on the stated maximum-degree-six images unless \(\mathrm{RP}=\mathrm{NP}\), even though the unfiltered orbit is a permanent with an FPRAS. Exact SCC factorization gives an output-sensitive algorithm in the local admissible matching fibers. Symmetrized FOBI-region inversion gives pointwise orbit-honest count coverage, with covariance convergence only modulo signed-row conjugacy and without a uniform graph-support or stability-boundary claim.

project_justification.gap: Published cyclic-LiNG methods enumerate or sample the full normalized row-assignment fiber and use stability as a candidate-level screen. They do not classify the complexity of the stability-filtered count or justify transferring permanent-based sampling guarantees through the global spectral restriction.
project_justification.niche: The missing object was a coefficient-valid realization controlling normalization, every unintended permutation, analytic multiplicity, absence of Schur-complement poles, and polynomial-bit spectral margins uniformly over the donor graph.
project_justification.fill: The rational graph gadget is proved to identify its complete stable assignment orbit with independent sets, yielding exact and approximate counting separations. The note also proves SCC factorization, an exact local enumerator whose complexity is output-sensitive in local admissible matchings on rational stable-reference inputs, and pointwise symmetrized FOBI confidence-image coverage.

body.related_work: Lacerda, Spirtes, Ramsey, and Hoyer characterize the cyclic LiNG row-permutation fiber and use Schur stability to screen candidates, but do not realize arbitrary independent-set systems. Sharifian, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash represent the ambiguity by perfect matchings, establish SCC invariance, and estimate intervention rewards from unfiltered matching samples; their sampler is therefore the direct consumer when equilibrium stability is additionally imposed. Jerrum, Sinclair, and Vigoda provide the nonnegative-permanent FPRAS for the unfiltered benchmark. Valiant's counting reduction and Sly's maximum-degree-six independent-set inapproximability provide the exact and approximation donors. The FOBI limit uses distinct centered standardized fourth cumulants; its confidence region is symmetrized over the signed row orbit, so covariance convergence is required only modulo signed-row conjugacy.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The analytic proof uses deliberately conservative contour and resolvent constants; the exact complete-orbit checks for \(K_2\), \(P_5\), \(C_5\), \(K_{1,4}\), and \(K_5\) reproduce stable counts \(3,13,11,17,6\) and serve only as independent finite sanity checks. The local enumeration bound is for rational stable-reference inputs and is output-sensitive in the local admissible matching fibers, not in the stable outputs alone. FOBI covariance convergence is only modulo signed-row conjugacy, and count-region coverage is pointwise rather than uniform at graph-support, eigengap, normalization, or unit-circle boundaries.
body.honest_scope: The proved contribution is the explicit rational stable-orbit realization and its one-call counting consequences. It does not establish an almost-uniform generator for the stable orbit, certificate hardness, a uniform graph-support recovery theorem, or stability-conditioned adaptive submodularity. SCC factorization and the local enumerator are exact on rational stable-reference inputs, with complexity depending on enumerated local admissible matchings. The FOBI result assumes distinct centered standardized fourth cumulants and gives pointwise orbit-honest confidence-image coverage; covariance is identified only modulo signed-row conjugacy, and no uniform singleton-count conclusion is claimed at discontinuity boundaries.
body.interpretation: The causal object is the number of Schur-stable mechanisms in the population-identified normalized ICA row orbit, not an arbitrary count attached to one ICA labeling and not an effect estimand. On the gadget image, that structural count equals \(|\mathcal I(G)|\) by theorem, rather than by definition. Thus matching frequencies and adaptive intervention scores in the downstream cyclic-LiNG design problem must be conditioned on the stable orbit whenever equilibrium stability is part of the model. The permanent FPRAS for all admissible assignments does not by itself approximate those stability-conditioned frequencies.
